cards.text: The Israelites are out of Egypt, following Moses, Israel's leader. They set out from Rephidim and walk into a new wilderness. Then they pitch camp right in front of a mountain.

cards.question: Israel is camped in front of a mountain. What wilderness are they in?
Israel arrives in the ___ month, on the same day of the month they left Egypt.

cards.text: Moses goes up to God, and the LORD calls to him from the mountain with a message for the house of Jacob.

cards.question: The LORD reminds Israel they saw what He did to Egypt. What picture does He use for how He carried them to Himself?

cards.text: Then comes the offer. If they will obey His voice and keep His covenant, something big is waiting for them.

cards.question: If Israel obeys the LORD and keeps His covenant, He says they will be His treasured ___ out of all the nations.
In His offer to Israel, the LORD says the whole earth is His.

cards.text: And He adds, "And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation." So Moses goes back down, calls the elders together and sets every word right in front of them.

cards.question: After Moses lays out everything the LORD said, the people answer that they will do everything the LORD has spoken.

cards.text: All the people answer together, so Moses carries their words back up to the LORD. Minty, one of my cookie cutter kids, used to carry messages from one end of the counter to the other, but she never had to climb a MOUNTAIN to do it.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses He'll come to him in a dense cloud. Why?

answers.text: So the people hear Him speak with Moses
So the people can't see the mountaintop
So their enemies can't find the camp

cards.text: And so the people will always put their trust in Moses. Then the LORD gives him a plan: consecrate the people today and tomorrow.

cards.question: While the people are being consecrated, the LORD says they must wash their ___.
The people have to be ready by the third day. What's happening then?

answers.text: The LORD will come down on Mount Sinai
The camp will move on toward Canaan
Moses will choose new leaders for Israel

cards.text: And it won't be private: the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people. Moses also has to set up a boundary around the mountain.

cards.question: Under the LORD's rules, the people may touch the base of the mountain as long as they don't climb it.

cards.text: The LORD warns that whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death. No hand is to touch that person, who must be stoned or shot with arrows.

cards.question: The rule about touching the mountain covers animals too, not just people.
Only when the ___ sounds a long blast may the people approach the mountain.

cards.text: Moses comes down, consecrates the people, and they all wash their clothes. I wear a white apron around melted chocolate every single day, friend, so I RESPECT a full-camp laundry day.
He tells them, "Be prepared for the third day," and "Do not draw near to a woman." Then the third day arrives, and morning comes over the camp.

cards.question: Morning comes on the third day. What breaks out?
A thick cloud sits on the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram's horn goes out, so that all the people in the camp ___.

cards.text: Then Moses brings the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stand at the foot of the mountain.

cards.question: Mount Sinai is completely covered in smoke. Why?

answers.text: The LORD descended on it in fire
The people burned offerings on it
Lightning set its trees on fire

cards.question: The smoke rising off Mount Sinai looks like the smoke of a ___.

cards.text: And the whole mountain quakes violently. I bet the people at the bottom are holding their breath, the way I did every time the junk drawer I used to live in rattled open.

cards.question: As the ram's horn grows louder and louder, Moses speaks and God answers him in a gentle whisper.

cards.text: God answers him in the thunder. Then the LORD descends to the top of Mount Sinai and calls Moses up to the summit, so Moses climbs AGAIN, and friend, that man's step count is going THROUGH THE ROOF.

cards.question: When Moses reaches the summit of Mount Sinai, the LORD tells him to go down and warn the people.
The LORD says the people must not break through to see Him, or many of them will ___.
The LORD says even the priests who approach Him must consecrate themselves.

cards.text: Or the LORD will break out against them. Then Moses answers the LORD, and he has something to say about the people coming up the mountain.

cards.question: Why does Moses tell the LORD the people can't come up Mount Sinai?

answers.text: The LORD already had them set a boundary
The climb is far too steep for them
The elders are guarding the only path

cards.text: The LORD replies: go down, and bring someone back up with you.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses to go down and bring ___ back up the mountain with him.

cards.text: But the priests and the people still must not break through to come up, or He will break out against them. So Moses goes down to the people one more time and speaks to them.
